**Trusted internal domains**: `api.cruitical.com` (REST + WebSocket backend), `www.cruitical.com` / `cruitical.com` (marketing site)
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: FastAPI API on ECS Fargate + Temporal Worker, Temporal Cloud (workflows, task queues), Neon PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, Cloudflare R2 object storage, Cloudflare Workers (Next.js SSR), WorkOS AuthKit, AWS Bedrock + AgentCore (separate account), Gemini via GCP Workload Identity Federation, ElevenLabs (`api.elevenlabs.io`), SES, CloudWatch alarms (`cruitical-*`) routed via EventBridge to the `cruitical-alerts` SNS topic
**Internal package registry**: None configured — dependencies come from public registries (`registry.npmjs.org`, PyPI via `uv`/`pip`)

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: production Neon Postgres and R2 hold candidate personal data (résumés, coffee-chat transcripts, names, profile pictures, employer/institution names as typed); a SELECT-everything read-only role still sees all production PII, so treat everything loaded through `apps/backend/scripts/_prod_readonly.py` as production personal data. Root `.env.prod.read-only`, `.env.backend`, `.env.postgres`, `.env.web`, `apps/web/.env.local`, `apps/backend/.env.eval`, `apps/backend/alt-wif-credential-config.json` and `wif_credential_config.json` hold credentials. Customer- and candidate-authored text (résumé lines, role titles, job descriptions, recruiter notes, company/institution names) must never be committed — only text we authored plus opaque ids. The `Cruitical/kb` repo holds fundraising, investor, customer and financial material. Share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar.

**Data retention / declassification**: git history is permanent — a committed user-derived artefact cannot be honoured for erasure without a history rewrite, so committed content is an allowlist of one directory with everything else gitignored. Soft-deleted companies/roles/candidates purge after a 30-day grace period via `PurgeSoftDeletedWorkflow`; Redis sessions 30-day TTL, preview/deep analysis caches 7-day TTL. Bedrock model-invocation logging and AgentCore request/response logging stay OFF so prompts are not written into a second store outside retention rules.

**Sensitive remote targets**: production Neon PostgreSQL and Cloudflare R2 (read-only via the `_prod_readonly.py` seam and the `cruitical_eval_ro` role / read-only R2 token; writes are server-refused), production ECS/ALB/WAF/SES in AWS infra account `826671498625`, the Bedrock account `744248319375`, Temporal Cloud namespaces, Upstash Redis, plus any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited — e.g. matches `prod-db`, not `producer`)

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: production ECS services and task definitions in `infra/application/` (CI-applied), the operator-applied roots `infra/bootstrap/`, `infra/bedrock/`, `infra/assessment/`, `infra/assessment-box/`, the Cloudflare Workers production deployment, and `main` (production branch)

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM/RBAC (`infra/bootstrap/iam.tf` deploy role, `infra/bedrock/iam.tf` model allowlist, cross-account trust policies), networking (VPC, security groups, ALB, WAF), Terraform state in `s3://cruitical-terraform-state-826671498625` and its `.tflock` objects, `allowed_account_ids` provider guards, quota/inference-profile and node-pool style resources, and anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
